title: The Rearview Echo

beats.text: [Fiction] Elias adjusted his cap, the damp fog of November 14, 2026, pressing against the windshield like a heavy, grey blanket.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome cinematic shot of a bus driver through a foggy windshield at night

beats.text: In the back row, a man in a salt-stained trench coat sat motionless, his reflection a static, faceless blur in the mirror.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome blurry rearview mirror reflection of a man in a dark coat on a bus

beats.text: Almost home now, Elias murmured to himself, his voice barely a ripple in the quiet, sterile air of the idling bus.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a bus driver's mouth moving slightly

beats.text: He reached the final depot and pulled the air brake, but the passenger remained as still as a carved, granite headstone.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome empty bus depot at night with heavy fog

beats.text: Elias walked down the narrow, dimly lit aisle, the scent of old rain and copper filling his lungs with every step.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome perspective looking down a bus aisle toward the back seats
beats.stock_query: inside of a bus at night

beats.text: Almost home now, he whispered, placing a trembling hand on the stranger’s shoulder, waiting for the inevitable, slow turn.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome close up of a hand touching a dark coat shoulder

beats.text: The man turned, revealing Elias’s own younger face, eyes wide with the raw grief of the night his daughter died.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome haunting face of a young man looking up in shock

beats.text: Elias didn't scream; he simply sat in the seat beside his former self and waited for the next route to begin.
beats.image_prompt: monochrome wide shot of two identical figures sitting together on a dark bus

disclosure: An original fictional horror story. Visuals are illustrative.
